Backend: all 40 pytest pass, GET /api/admin/health returns {status:ok,namespace:admin}, /api/forces/{id}/export is byte-identical to /api/forces/{id} (both 93634B) and returns 404 for unknown ids. Migration harness runs cleanly on restart (no schema changes, still at head d6f3e50ef277), and /api/health, /api/forces, /api/admin/health all 200 post-restart. Existing campaign data (ghost-bear=Bluefang Trinary 18M/18P, 91st-division 24M/24P) untouched. Frontend: admin-entry-btn visible in header, opens modal with admin-view-placeholder ('Admin area – work in progress') and no functional controls; closes via X button and via backdrop click. ui_bugs.issue: DialogContent was destructuring only {className, children, onClose} and dropping all other props including data-testid. As a result data-testid='admin-view-modal' set in AdminView.jsx never reached the DOM (though the modal rendered visually). Fixed in this session by adding ...props spread on the outer div so extra HTML attributes (data-testid, aria-*, etc.) are forwarded.

action_items: Review the small fix in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/dialog.jsx (added ...props spread on DialogContent's outer div) - it is safe and required so that data-testid='admin-view-modal' is present in the DOM per the acceptance criteria. This also benefits any other future consumers of DialogContent that want to pass data-testid / aria attributes.

OPTIONAL/informational only: the exported <force-id>.json downloaded by the browser is content-equivalent to /api/forces/{id}/export but NOT byte-identical because downloadJSON() re-serializes with indentation (176KB vs 94KB). The two backend endpoints /api/forces/{id} and /api/forces/{id}/export ARE byte-identical, matching the acceptance criteria wording. No action needed unless byte-identical downloaded-file behavior is desired.

critical_code_review_comments: components/ui/dialog.jsx: DialogContent should spread rest props (fixed). This is a general shadcn-style bug that would silently drop any custom HTML attributes on the dialog content wrapper.

AdminView.jsx / DialogContent: minor - the shadcn DialogContent from this repo does not accept an `onClose` prop pattern by convention (real shadcn dialogs use Radix's own close primitive); works fine for scaffolding but consider standardizing on Radix Dialog.Close for future admin sub-panels.
handleExport in App.js: swallows only api errors; falls back to alert(). Consider a toast/inline error surface for consistency with the rest of the app.

Only one fix was applied (dialog.jsx DialogContent now forwards ...props so data-testid gets to the DOM); if main agent prefers to route the data-testid differently (e.g., on a wrapper inside AdminView.jsx instead of DialogContent), they can revert dialog.jsx and adjust AdminView.jsx. rca of the issue: Root cause of the data-testid=admin-view-modal absence: /app/frontend/src/components/ui/dialog.jsx DialogContent function signature was `({ className, children, onClose })` which explicitly ignores any extra props (including data-testid) passed by callers. React then attaches only the destructured props to the underlying div. Fix: change signature to `({ className, children, onClose, ...props })` and spread `{...props}` on the outer div. Reproduction: open the admin modal, run `document.querySelector('[data-testid="admin-view-modal"]')` in devtools -> null before fix, an element after fix. `admin-view-placeholder` was always present because that testid is set on a plain <div>, not on DialogContent.
